title: Minister Joe's special-needs youth group talks about the Hill
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Minister Joe's special-needs youth group talks about the Hill, about c. 2023 at a megachurch (unspecified), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he was saying that some of his uh kids in his youth group were talking about the hill

plain: Ky Dickens, a filmmaker who made a documentary about non-speaking children she says can read minds, tells this on podcast host Jesse Michels' show. She says a minister named Joe, who ran a youth group for children with special needs at a large church, told her around 2023 that some of the kids in his group were talking about "the Hill", a place she says came up among the children. If true, it would mean children who had never met were describing the same shared place.
